body:
> We remove the singleRefine option form the refinementList widget (we keep it in the component). We already have the menu widget for that. Maybe this is not the best name, but we can work on finding a better name on another issue (singleSelection, radioList, ...)

I am up for it but also concerned. If I want to make a refinementList out of radio buttons, I will need the singleRefine option. Of course I can use menu to do so, but really menu is sugar on top of refinementList. So from the docs, I would go for refinementList. That's why I am unsure about removing this option.

It's currently not restricting us to do anything right? So let's keep it and see if we need to remove it later on?
